name: Monitor has no power
description: The monitor does not turn on and no power light appears.
steps: Press the monitor power button once|Make sure the power cable is firmly connected to the monitor and wall outlet|Test the wall outlet with another device|Disconnect the power cable for 30 seconds then reconnect it
warning: Stop if the cable or monitor looks damaged or smells unusual.

name: Monitor shows no signal
description: The monitor turns on but says no signal or stays blank.
model: Dell monitors using HDMI or DisplayPort
steps: Make sure the laptop or desktop is awake|Reconnect the video cable at both ends|Use the monitor input button to select the connected HDMI or DisplayPort input|Restart the computer with the monitor connected
warning: Do not force a cable into a port. Contact IT if a port is bent or damaged.

name: Monitor picture flickers
description: The screen flashes or the picture appears unstable.
steps: Reconnect the video cable at both ends|Remove any loose adapter and reconnect it|Restart the computer|Try another approved cable if one is available
warning: Stop if the screen is cracked or the monitor becomes unusually hot.

name: Docking station is not detected
description: The laptop does not recognize the dock after it is connected.
steps: Disconnect the dock cable from the laptop|Disconnect power from the dock for 30 seconds|Reconnect dock power|Reconnect the dock cable directly to the laptop|Restart the laptop if the dock is still not detected
warning: Use the approved power adapter and contact IT if the connector is loose or damaged.

name: External monitors do not work through the dock
description: The dock is connected but one or more external displays stay blank.
location: Dock video ports and laptop connection
steps: Confirm the monitors have power|Reconnect each video cable|Reconnect the dock cable to the laptop|Open display settings and check for the external displays|Restart the laptop with the dock connected
warning: Contact IT if the dock or a cable is damaged.

name: USB device does not work through the dock
description: A keyboard mouse or other USB device is not responding through the dock.
steps: Disconnect and reconnect the USB device|Try another USB port on the dock|Reconnect the dock cable to the laptop|Restart the laptop
warning: Do not connect unknown or damaged USB devices.

name: Laptop will not power on
description: The laptop does not start when the power button is pressed.
steps: Disconnect the dock and other accessories|Connect the approved AC adapter directly to the laptop|Check whether the charging or power light appears|Hold the power button for 15 seconds then release it|Press the power button normally
warning: Stop and contact IT if the laptop is swollen smoking wet or unusually hot.

name: Laptop battery is not charging
description: The laptop runs from the adapter but the battery percentage does not increase.
steps: Check that the adapter is connected firmly at the wall and laptop|Reconnect the adapter|Restart the laptop|Check the battery icon again after a few minutes
warning: Do not continue if the battery case is swollen. Disconnect power and contact IT.

name: Laptop shows a blinking diagnostic light
description: The laptop repeats an amber or white light pattern instead of starting normally.
steps: Write down the color and number of blinks|Disconnect accessories but leave the approved power adapter connected|Try to start the laptop one more time|Contact IT and report the light pattern
warning: Do not open the laptop or remove internal parts.
